title: THE 3D-PC: A BENCHMARK FOR VISUAL PERSPECTIVE TAKING IN HUMANS AND MACHINES
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 3D spatial reasoning and visual perspective-taking capabilities in humans and machines (including VLMs). It does not contain any components evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics; it only contains a standard 'Potential Negative Societal Impacts' section in the appendix which is excluded per the instructions.
